subject.title: fix(models): clear stale auth cooldowns after early limit resets

question: Should OpenClaw support `models auth clear-cooldown <profile-id>` as the explicit operator escape hatch for a provider that recovered before its stored cooldown deadline?
rationale: The patch is mechanically bounded, but selecting a permanent public recovery surface—and whether it should instead be automatic or guided—requires maintainer product intent.

options.title: Adopt the explicit reset
options.body: Keep the profile-scoped command as an opt-in operator recovery action after redacted end-to-end proof confirms owner-store clearing, safe restart, and successful retry.

options.title: Use guided recovery instead
options.body: Pause this command and place the action in Doctor or an in-product recovery flow so affected users do not need to understand auth-profile state.

options.title: Rely on automatic recovery
options.body: Close this PR if maintainers want recovery handled only by provider probing and cooldown policy rather than manual state mutation.

recommendation.title: Adopt the explicit reset
recommendation.body: Keep the profile-scoped command as an opt-in operator recovery action after redacted end-to-end proof confirms owner-store clearing, safe restart, and successful retry.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal combines auth-profile refactor and cooldown-state merger responsibility.
